cards.original_source_block: When she gets there Regina hears screams over the radio and when the elevator arrives, our friend Tyrannousaurus arrives for dinner, but ends up getting the biggest shock and passes out, but the place is left without power, examine the battery device and get the battery that Rick had placed there, go to the place where you got it and use it on the device, examine it and choose options A, C, D and Cancel to restore power, go to the large elevator and examine the bodies to get a Plug , the Port Card Key and the DDK Input Disk D, return to the room where Rick is and Regina gives him the Port Card Key, with it Rick will open a passage in this room, but upon entering it they discover a kind of portal that should to have been a side effect of Kirk’s experiments, after the conversation, take the DDK Code Disk S and head to the place where you got the first B2 Key Chip, put the two Key chips in the slots next to the screen on the wall and examine it , enter the password 0392 and move the blocks to form the figures beneath them, when you succeed, exit and examine the panel next to the door at the end, enter the password STABILIZER to open it, go straight ahead until the next door, Now go

cards.original_source_block: You will see a scientist who is trapped in a room with poisonous gas, examine the panel ahead and choose the options: BLUE, GREEN, GRENN, RED and BLUE, to neutralize the gas, go in and talk to him, before he dies he gives you the B1 Key Chip, examine his body to get a Small Size Key, try to leave and a raptor attacks you, get rid of him and if you want, turn on the gas to kill him, go to the room where you got the Handgun Sights and examine the blue screen on the wall, use the B1 Key Chip on it and enter the password 3695, now you will have to arrange the blocks according to the figure below, it is not difficult, when you do, go to the place where you lit a green light, use the B1 Key Chip there to get the Keycard R, go to the Computer Room and go to the screen on the wall, there are two card slots on each side of it, use the Key Card L in the left slot, but you need to Let two people swipe both cards at the same time, choose Yes to call Gail, when he arrives, they will both open a door, but there is one more behind it, examine the panel on the side and enter the password ENERGY to open it. there.
